accepted_local_findings.finding: Only one active read is expanded; next read does not enter active expander until native commands of the current AXI burst finish.
RD_PRI_REG chooses translated read versus write commands. QOS is used as nonzero opposite-channel hint at AXI burst command boundary; no read-versus-read QOS selection.
mc_app_hi_pri is hardwired zero; new external QOS cannot rewrite active read metadata and no per-request cancel/reorder/update interface is exposed.

Native bank service may reorder, but UI restores original read order, and shim uses sequential data and transaction-metadata FIFO for RID and RLAST. Same and different IDs do not offer PTE bypass on this implementation.
The 32-address-cell upsizer command FIFO stores R/W unpacking plans, not address/ID/QOS scheduling entries. The transaction FIFO has 30 native-command metadata entries, not 30 entire AXI read bursts.
Visible held R beat is stable until handshake; lowering RREADY cannot select PTE instead.

RD_PRI_REG threshold logic is opportunity/command based, gated by mc_app_rdy; starve releases hold at burst boundary. It is not a universal 256-wall-clock-cycle PTE or response bound. Do not import logic from RD_PRI_REG_STARVE_LIMIT.
